name: Browser Login
description: Log in with a login or passkey saved in this workspace's vault without seeing it; it works only on its own site. list: the saved logins and passkeys and which fit this page. login: fill a login into user_ref and/or pass_ref from the last read. code: fill its current 2FA code into ref. passkey: sign in with a saved passkey by clicking ref, the page's button that signs in with a passkey. ask (on the sign-in page, when none is saved): returns a card where the user saves one; put it in your reply and end the reply. Some wait for the user's OK first. Never ask for a password in the chat.
author: anything

examples.prompt: (on GitHub's sign-in page, and the list has no login for github.com)
(the list shows 7c01e2aa, a passkey for github.com, and the page has a "Sign in with a passkey" button e7)

action.description: list, login, code, passkey or ask.

login.description: The login's or passkey's id, from list.

user_ref.description: login: the username or email field's ref (e12).

ref.description: code: the 2FA code field's ref. passkey: the button that signs in with a passkey.

submit.description: Press Enter in the last field filled.
